crumbs.name: Knowledge Based Professions and their Future

children.name: Finding Acquisition Targets
children.blurb: Finding acquisition targets is the front end of private equity and deal sourcing, where a firm turns an investment thesis into a list of companies worth contacting.

children.name: Data Room Diligence
children.blurb: Data room diligence is the structured review of documents that a target company places in a secure virtual data room during a private equity or merger and acquisition process.

children.name: Buyout Modelling
children.blurb: Buyout modelling is the quantitative representation of a leveraged acquisition, covering sources and uses of funds, debt tranches, cash flow sweeps, exit assumptions, and returns such as internal rate of return and multiple of invested capital.

children.name: Private Market Valuation
children.blurb: Private market valuation is the practice of estimating what a private company or a private asset is worth when no public market price exists.

children.name: Tracking Synergies After a Merger
children.blurb: Tracking synergies after a merger means measuring whether the combined company performs better than the standalone businesses would have, across cost, revenue, and capital efficiency.

sections.body: Private equity and deal sourcing is the work of finding companies to buy, checking them, pricing them, and then making the combined business worth more than the parts. AI is now used to scan large sets of companies, news, filings, and web signals to surface possible targets. In diligence, models read data room documents, pull out contract terms, flag missing items, and compare them against prior deals. In buyout modelling, AI helps build and test assumptions, run scenarios, and draft memos, though the model does not decide the deal. After a merger, AI can track operational metrics and customer data to see whether promised synergies are appearing. This is not a fully automated process, it is a set of tools that speed up parts of a human-led workflow.
sections.heading: What this covers

sections.body: The work stands at a practical middle stage. Sourcing tools can rank and cluster targets, but they still depend on clean data and clear criteria, and private company data is often incomplete. Diligence has seen real gains in document review and extraction, yet models can miss context, invent details, or mishandle confidential material. Buyout models are faster to build and stress test, but the core question of what a business is worth remains a judgment call. Private market valuation is harder than public market valuation because there are fewer comparable transactions and less disclosure, and the site tracks 393 merger and acquisition filings, which shows the kind of public record that can support this work but does not cover the private deals that never appear there. Synergy tracking is possible in some cases, but measuring causation after a merger is not solved.
sections.heading: Where the work stands

sections.body: The pages here follow the deal sequence and can be read in that order or by need. Finding Acquisition Targets covers how AI narrows a market into a shortlist and what signals it uses. Data Room Diligence covers document review, extraction, and risk flags during the confidential review stage. Buyout Modelling covers the financial model, scenario work, and how AI assists without replacing the analyst. Private Market Valuation covers the harder problem of pricing companies that do not trade on an exchange. Tracking Synergies After a Merger covers the post close work of checking whether the combined company is delivering what the deal promised, so a reader focused on post deal execution would go there.
